onboarding.future_desc: FrigoRadar uses AI to remove manual entry. Take a photo and the fridge updates itself.
onboarding.receipt_desc: Snap a photo of your grocery receipt and the AI adds every product to the fridge with estimated expiry dates.
onboarding.photo_desc: Photograph the expiry date: the AI reads it. Scan the barcode: product added with photo, calories and nutrients.
onboarding.chef_desc: The AI Chef looks at what's about to expire in your fridge and creates tailored, star-worthy recipes. Zero waste.
onboarding.loyalty_desc: Scan your card and always carry it with you. The AI automatically picks up points and coupons from receipts.
onboarding.family_desc: Share the fridge with family or flatmates. Everyone sees products in real time, adds items and collaborates on shopping.
onboarding.demo_recipe: "Pasta with 🧀 Parmesan, 🍳 egg and 🥓 bacon: expires today!"

tutorial.welcome_desc: In 30 seconds we'll show you how to get the most out of the app. You can skip at any time.
tutorial.scan_receipt_desc: Tap the + button in the middle, then choose "Grocery receipt". The AI reads every product and expiry date automatically.
tutorial.add_product_title: 🛒 Add products to your shopping list
tutorial.add_product_desc: In the Shopping tab you can add products to buy. The app automatically suggests what has run out in the fridge.
tutorial.recipes_desc: Tap AI Chef: the AI sees what's about to expire and creates tailored recipes, so nothing goes to waste.
tutorial.barcode_desc: Tap + then "Product photo" or the scanner: the app adds photo, calories, ingredients and category automatically.
tutorial.loyalty_desc: In the Cards tab you'll find all your loyalty cards. Add them once, use them at the store without carrying them.

feedback.q_confusione: Was there a moment you didn't know what to do?
feedback.ph_confusione: Even just "I couldn't find the button to...".
feedback.q_desideri: What would you add or remove?
feedback.ph_desideri: The thing you miss the most.

feedback.thanks_sub: Your answer has arrived. This is how FrigoRadar stops being what I imagine and becomes what you need.

delete_account.title: Delete your FrigoRadar account
delete_account.in_app_text: Open FrigoRadar, go to Profile and choose Delete account. Deletion starts immediately, without going through us.
delete_account.no_app: If you no longer have the app
delete_account.no_app_text: Write to <mail/> from the email address you signed up with, asking for your account to be deleted. We reply within 30 days, as required by the GDPR.
delete_account.partial_text: You don't have to close your account to get rid of something. From the app you can delete individual products, uploaded photos, loyalty cards and the shopping list at any time, and turn off notifications from Profile. If you'd rather have a specific piece of data deleted, write to : your account stays active.
deleted_list: The fridge, freezer and pantry inventory
The product and receipt photos you uploaded
The shopping list and consumption history
delete_account.kept: What remains, and for how long
delete_account.kept_text: Nothing traceable to you. Only the data the law requires us to keep remains: PRO subscription payment receipts, held by Stripe for tax purposes. Everything else is deleted within 30 days of the request.
